:::{#def-uncorrelated}
#### Uncorrelated random variables

[Random variables](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $X$ and $Y$
with $\E{X^2} < \infty$ and $\E{Y^2} < \infty$
are **uncorrelated** when their [covariance](#def-cov) is 0:

$$\Cov{X,Y} = 0$$

:::

::: {.remark .notes}

@thm-indpt-uncorrelated says [independent](independence.qmd#def-indpt) [random variables](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) are [uncorrelated](#def-uncorrelated),
and @exm-uncorrelated-not-indpt shows the [converse](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-converse) fails.

:::
